{{Quote|That last hologram he triggered&mdash;the one he mocked&mdash;was Nield's father. He went into battle with Nield's three brothers. They all died. Nield was five years old. One month later his mother made preparations to be part of the next great battle. She left him with a cousin, a young girl who was more like a sister to him. His mother went off to fight, and she was killed too.|Cerasi, recounting Nield's childhood to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="JA5" />}}
Around [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a '''battle''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]]. It was just one of the many conflicts in the [[Melida/Daan Civil War|war]] between the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] and [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] tribes. The battle took place one [[Standard month/Legends|month]] after the Daan [[Micae]] and his [[Nield's oldest brother|three]] [[Nield's second-oldest brother|oldest]] [[Nield's third-oldest brother|sons]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in [[Unidentified battle (Micae's death)|another battle]].<ref name="JA5" /> Micae's [[Gender/Legends|wife]], [[Leidra]],<ref name="JA6">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Uncertain Path]]''</ref> participated in the battle after leaving their last son, [[Nield]], with his [[Nield's cousin|cousin]]. Leidra was killed herself in the battle, leaving Nield an orphan.<ref name="JA5" /> [[44 BBY/Legends|About eight years later]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Nield's friend [[Cerasi]] would recount the struggles of his childhood, including this battle, to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="JA5" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was mentioned in the [[1999]] young readers book [[Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead|''The Defenders of the Dead'']], the fifth entry in [[Jude Watson]]'s [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|''Jedi Apprentice'']] young readers series.<ref name="JA5" />
